- Executive summary of most recent penetration test (high-level findings + remediation status)

Hi Alice —

Appreciate the clear list. We can deliver all four artifacts; a few notes up front:

- SOC 2 Type II: we have a 2026 report. We can provide a redacted PDF (control narratives removed) or the full report under an NDA overlay.
- Pen test exec summary: we have an internal executive summary we can share immediately; the full pentest report requires a controlled download (external-facing exec summary attached).
- ISO: Redwood maintains ISO27001 statements for our Private deployment scope — I'll include the formal statement.
- Security deck: I'll attach the latest v5 security overview with a short appendix addressing SIG control mappings.

Plan: I will attach the exec-level artifacts now (SOC 2 redacted, pen test exec summary, ISO statement, deck). For the full SOC 2 and pen test report we can provision secure links and an NDA if MedScale wants them.

Deliverables sent in this thread (see attachments). If you want the full documents, please confirm the intended reviewers and we will send DocuSign NDA + secure transfer link.

Best,
Mina Haddad

mina.haddad@redwood.com

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the flag. Confirming: our ISO27001 statement covers the Redwood Private control plane and hosted inference surfaces listed in the scope appendix. I'll paste the exact scope sentence below for procurement copy/paste.

"Redwood Inference ISO/IEC 27001:2013 — Scope: Design, development, and operation of the Redwood inference platform, including hosted inference API endpoints, Redwood Console (observability and management), and associated private deployment options (VPC/on-prem) for customers."

Regarding the NDA + full SOC 2: please route the standard NDA to legal@redwood.com and copy me. We will push the DocuSign package and provide a secure download once the mutual NDA is executed. Expected turnaround: 24–48 hours after signing.

For convenience: provisional secure links (read-only) to the full reports will be staged at the Drive folder below once NDA is in place.
